sentences.en: The spirit of the climbers is truly unconquerable.
sentences.zh: 登山者的精神真是不可征服的。

sentences.en: Her will to survive was an unconquerable force.
sentences.zh: 她生存的意志是一种不可征服的力量。

sentences.en: The love between them is so deep, it seems almost unconquerable.
sentences.zh: 他们之间的爱如此深厚，几乎不可征服。

senses.zh: 不可征服的,克服不了的,压制不了的
